verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's official integration pages offer a ready-made UI path: they pair Meilisearch with React InstantSearch for building search interfaces (meilisearch-docs-72) and point Angular users to InstantSearch components (meilisearch-docs-86). Faceting is documented as powering category navigation in a UI (meilisearch-docs-26). However, the component library is InstantSearch rather than a Meilisearch-native kit, and the evidence never lists the specific widgets. Missing for 10: confirmation of a first-party or officially maintained adapter, documented search-box/results/facet/pagination components, coverage of other frameworks such as Vue or vanilla JS, and independent hands-on corroboration.
